content:
Your Thunderbird data must be in version 128.5.0 before you can add the accounts to Android.

So first, to move from Thunderbird 115 on computer A to 128 on computer B:

  • https://support.mozilla.org/kb/moving-thunderbird-data-to-a-new-computer
  • or https://support.mozilla.org/kb/thunderbird-import

Then to get your accounts (but not your data) to android https://support.mozilla.org/kb/thunderbird-android-import
